description: Every week, the Daily Mail asks two singletons to report back from their Blind Date. This week, Melissa and Lewis recount their dinner date experience. Read on to find out how it went...
title: Tequila shots, lingering kisses and flirtatious selfies... so is this the Mail's steamiest BLIND DATE ever?
